title: Medusa

evidence.layout: Pointer table at CPU $F35D, 27 phrases, each a 4-byte (start, end) record.
evidence.independent_check: The board's own firmware was run and the byte stream it sends the TMS captured and located back in the ROM. It plays 26 streams from 26 distinct addresses spanning $D000-$EF5E. Every one of those streams falls inside a phrase this layout converts.
evidence.conversion: 1567 frames converted, all keeping their frame kind when the output was re-parsed with the target tables.
evidence.emulation: The converted devices were loaded into a simulation of the Squawk & Talk board, which booted and issued the same 16 SPEAK EXTERNAL commands as the original set.
evidence.not_verified: No converted ROM from this profile has been played on a real board. Nobody has heard it.
evidence.phrases_not_observed: The layout declares 1 phrase(s) the trace never saw played ($D334). They are table entries like any other and convert the same way; the commands that reach them are simply not among those the simulation issues.

notes: This sound ROM set is shared by 3 game revisions: medusa, medusaa, medusaf.
The table stores both bounds of every phrase as a 4-byte (start, end) record, not a list of starts.
